And when she eats her lunch, she always prays for over ten minutes before she starts.
I can't tell what she's saying, but she mutters away in a tiny voice, mumble mumble mumble.
Then she bows to her lunch box over and over and over.
And only then does she finally start eating.
Unbelievable, right?
And when she eats, she must chew every bite more than thirty times.
I mean, she eats incredibly slowly.
She uses up the whole lunch break eating.
Then, when she's done, she bows to her lunch box again and starts praying, mumble mumble mumble.
She's unhinged, huh?
Kind of scary, right?
But you know, it's not like she's dumb.
She's actually pretty good at studying.
She always ranks near the top on tests and stuff.
And she doesn't get bullied, either.
It kind of bugs me to say it as a girl myself, but she's really cute.
You know, the kind of face everybody likes?
Girls like that have it easy, huh?
Even me, sometimes I find Sanae really irritating, but then I go, 'Oh, whatever,' and forgive her right away.
Actually, we're pretty good friends.
Maybe I'm weird too.
Besides, Sanae may be weird, but she's fun.{p}
